Corollary
[Uniqueness scale for minima of $f$ (Corollary 27.13)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0032 ↗ thm:chow-iv-potential-lower-bound 1. ch27:27.13\group Potential estimates

If $O_1,O_2$ are minimum points of a complete normalized shrinker, then $d(O_1,O_2)\le 35n/8+\sqrt{2n}$.
